website_summary.name: Entrepreneurial Insights Hub
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and organized layout with a focus on sharing entrepreneurial stories and strategies, featuring a soft old lace background and rosy brown interface elements.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a minimalist yet visually appealing design. It has a header with a logo ("創業說") and navigation buttons for logging in and registering. Below the header, there is a search bar for finding specific articles. The main content area displays articles in a grid format, each with an image, title, brief description, publication date, and interaction icons for liking and sharing. Articles are categorized into various topics such as "成功故事" (Success Stories), "創業經驗" (Entrepreneurial Experience), and others. The background uses a soft old lace color (#FDF5E6), while the interface elements are styled in rosy brown (#BC8F8F), creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.
website_summary.functionality:
The website includes several key functionalities:
- **Article Browsing:** Users can browse through articles categorized by topics like success stories, entrepreneurial experience, business strategies, etc.
- **Search Functionality:** A search bar allows users to find articles by entering keywords.
- **Article Interaction:** Users can like and share articles using provided icons.
- **User Authentication:** Login and registration buttons enable users to create accounts and manage their collections and reading history.
- **Category Filtering:** Users can filter articles by selecting different category buttons.

functionality_testing.name: Exploration of Unseen Elements through Scroll
functionality_testing.objective: To verify if relevant content regarding "成功故事" appears further down the page by exploring using a scroll action.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The search term "成功故事" is entered, and the webpage is in a state where more content can be revealed by scrolling.
procedure: Verify the appearance of new articles and their relevance to "成功故事."
Next Steps : Click on one of the related articles to explore potential relevant content to "成功故事."

functionality_testing.name: Related Articles Interaction Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking on related article links displays information relevant to the search term "成功故事."
functionality_testing.preconditions: The main search bar contains "成功故事," and the related articles are visible.
functionality_testing.expected_results: One or more related articles should contain relevant content about "成功故事."
procedure: Click on a related article from Textual elements in "相關文章".
Verify the article for relevance to "成功故事."

functionality_testing.name: Search Bar Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that entering text in the Search Bar and pressing enter displays relevant articles.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Website is loaded, and the search bar is visible.
functionality_testing.expected_results: A list of articles related to "成功故事" should appear.
procedure: Type "成功故事" into the Search Bar.
Press Enter to initiate the search.
Verify that relevant articles appear below the search bar.

functionality_testing.name: 商業策略 Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the 商業策略 button filters the articles to display only those related to business strategies.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The homepage is loaded with all category buttons visible.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The article grid should filter out all non-relevant articles, displaying only those related to business strategies.
procedure: Click on the 商業策略 button.
Verify that the article grid updates to display only articles related to business strategies.

data_display_testing.name: Article Card 1 Display Test
data_display_testing.objective: Verify that the content of Article Card 1 is displayed accurately.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The article data should be displayed accurately. 7. Next Steps : Hover over the first article card to verify its details.
procedure: Verify that the title, date, and summary are displayed correctly.

design_validation_testing.name: UI Design and Style Test: Alignment
design_validation_testing.objective: To verify that all UI elements are properly aligned without overlapping or misalignment issues.
design_validation_testing.expected_results: All UI elements should be properly aligned without any overlapping or misalignment issues. 7. Next Steps : Perform the second test case to validate the alignment of UI elements.
procedure: Observe the alignment of the header, footer, and article card.
Ensure there are no overlapping elements.
Verify that the elements are neatly aligned.
